answers.explanation: Alice submits it, her MTA finds Bob's server through DNS, the MTAs talk SMTP, the MDA files it, and Bob's MUA fetches it.
Mail for bob@example.com goes wherever example.com's MX says.
Delivery is to Bob's server. His laptop picks the message up later with IMAP or POP.
Store and forward: it waits in the queue and the MTA tries again.
IMAP keeps mail on the server, so every device sees the same folders. You'll meet it properly later in the chapter.
The user agent is the program the person sees. The other agents run on servers.
